title: [PDF] Ergothioneine - Alzheimer's Drug Discovery Foundation
abstract: Types of evidence: • 1 clinical trial assessing sleep in healthy volunteers • 5 observational studies (l-ergothioneine levels) • 1 observational study on mushroom intake and cognition • Numerous laboratory studies Human research to suggest prevention of dementia, prevention of decline, or improved cognitive function? Although this does not provide direct evidence for an effect by l-ergothioneine, baseline plasma l-ergothioneine levels were positively associated with cognitive performance on executive, visuospatial, visuomotor speed, and 5 Last updated on November 28, 2022 memory domains, in a subgroup of elderly individuals without dementia from a memory clinic cohort (n=470) .
